archive.refusedTitle: The branch cannot be archived yet

kinds.refundDue: Cancelled order, money not given back

archived.body: No till can sell here and its branch agent is no longer accepted. Its orders, payments, shifts and reports stay. Restore it to use it again; the agent then has to be enrolled again.

restore.done: Branch restored. Enrol its branch agent again to print and take card payments.

pos.stillSells: You can still take orders; they are marked after hours.

noBranch.title: You have no branch to work in
noBranch.body: The branch you worked at has been archived. Ask head office to give you another branch; your account and PIN stay as they are.

online.title: Online orders

laneEmpty.ACCEPTED: Nothing accepted waiting to go out

online.report: Tell {{platform}}: more time or a problem

issue.PLATFORM_CANCELLED: {{platform}} cancelled this order. Stop making it.
issue.TIMED_OUT: Not answered in time, so it was rejected automatically.

online.noShift: No shift is open at this branch. Open one to accept online orders.
online.waitingBehindShift: {{count}} online orders need you. Open the shift to answer them.
online.empty: No online orders right now. New ones pop up here with a sound.
online.noBranch: Choose a restaurant branch to see its online orders.

pause.today: Closed for the rest of today

rejectDialog.title: Reject order {{code}}
rejectDialog.hint: {{platform}} is told why. Nothing reaches the kitchen.

reportDialog.title: Order {{code}}: tell {{platform}}
reportDialog.hint: {{platform}} cannot change the time or the items after you accept. This hands the order to {{platform}} support, who call you and the customer, then cancel it or send it back for you to accept with a new time. The kitchen keeps cooking meanwhile.

issue.TIMED_OUT: Order {{code}} was not answered in time and was rejected.

toast.accepted: Order {{code}} accepted and sent to the kitchen
toast.failed: That did not go through. Another till may have answered it first.

errors.NO_OPEN_SHIFT: No shift is open at this branch. Open one first, or reject the order.
errors.PROMISE_OVER_PLATFORM_LIMIT: The platform takes at most {{maxMinutes}} min for this order.
errors.SEND_OUT_FROM_DISPATCH: Our courier takes this one. Send it out from Dispatch.
errors.REPORT_WINDOW_CLOSED: Too late to send this ({{windowMinutes}} min after accepting). Call the platform’s support.
errors.REPORT_ALREADY_OPEN: This order is already with the platform’s support.
errors.ORDER_NOT_IN_KITCHEN: The kitchen no longer has this order.

coupons.title: Coupons
coupons.subtitle: Batches of one-time codes for a campaign. Each code works once at the till.
coupons.freeProductHelp: One of it is free; it must be on the order.

errors.loadFailed: The coupon batches could not be loaded
errors.saveFailed: The coupon batch could not be saved
errors.copyFailed: The codes could not be copied

customerGroups.title: Customer groups
customerGroups.subtitle: Groups of customers, such as staff, owners or regulars, and the discounts each group gets. Add people to groups from the customer list.
customerGroups.loadFailed: The groups could not be loaded
customerGroups.saveFailed: The groups could not be saved
customerGroups.groupsHelp: A customer can be in several groups. Branch managers add and remove their own branch's people in the groups open to branches; the rest are head office's.
customerGroups.name: Name
customerGroups.removeWithMembers_one: Remove group; its {{count}} person leaves it
customerGroups.removeWithMembers_other: Remove group; its {{count}} people leave it
customerGroups.discountsHelp: A percent off at the till for the customers in the groups it picks. A customer in several groups gets the biggest one that applies.
customerGroups.limitsHelp: An extra beyond Toast, Square and Lightspeed, for staff schemes like Iran Burger's. Both caps are how much of the customer's orders the discount covers; above the cap per order the rest is full price. The month is the calendar month and does not carry over.
